main_interpretation: V36 did not fail because ideas were biologically implausible; it failed to promote them because strict gates exposed recurring fragility: multiplicity/overfit, composition/confounder sensitivity, therapy-branch specificity, small-n power limits, and missing decisive metadata/modalities.
surviving_narrow_signal: B/plasma-like IFN/APC remodeling remains the most stable internal carrier, but it is still single-cohort and validation-gated.
